Subject: GreenWave vendor onboarding — initial buyer intake & remit details request

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor setup with us. To get GreenWave created in our procurement system and to make sure first invoices flow without delays, we need a few items from your side. I’ve attached our standard onboarding checklist (single PDF) but outlined the essentials below so it’s easy to copy into an email: 

Required to create vendor record and enable POs:
- Legal entity name (exact as on W-9)
- Tax ID / EIN (or SSN if sole proprietor) — you can mask all but last 4 digits if you prefer over email
- Remit-to address (for paper checks if needed)
- Remit preference: ACH or Wire
- Bank details for ACH: bank name, routing number, account number (we typically request a voided check or bank letter for validation)
- W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax form

Other helpful items:
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone)
- Does GreenWave require a Purchase Order to be submitted prior to invoice? If so, any special PO notes required?
- Any billing terms exceptions (Net30, Net45, early-pay discounts, etc.)

We also use a DocuSign PowerForm for non-sensitive vendor onboarding forms if you prefer a secure link versus email attachments. I can send that link if helpful.

Next steps: if you can reply with the items above (or attach the W-9 + voided check), I’ll start the vendor creation and run it through finance for ACH setup. If there’s anything sensitive, we can arrange a secure upload.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0189
